item.title: Google Moves Pixel Production to Vietnam, India by 2027
item.description: Google will cease all Pixel manufacturing in China, relocating phones, watches and earbuds to Vietnam and India, with full transition slated for 2027.

item.title: US Blocks Apple’s Chinese Memory Chip Purchase: Why It Matters
item.description: US opposes Apple’s plan to buy Chinese memory chips, citing national security risks. Explore the tech, geopolitical, and supply chain implications.

item.title: Apple Pushes for 20% OLED Price Cut in iPhone 18 Pro Max
item.description: Apple negotiates a steep 20% OLED panel price cut for iPhone 18 Pro Max to offset rising memory costs, targeting $66.50 per panel.
